boundaries.name: rust_plonky2_refinement
boundaries.obligation: Handwritten fields, control flow and operation program must be linked to actual Rust/Plonky2 compilation and proof verification; FieldLowering is not discharged.

boundaries.name: primitive-semantics-faithfulness
boundaries.obligation: each `BuildOp.holds` case equals what the corresponding plonky2 primitive enforces; the pinned circuit digest is the digest of `constructorProgram`

boundaries.name: field_arithmetic
boundaries.obligation: Canonical Goldilocks representatives, all32-bit range gadgets, equality/select/sum,33-bit shifted subtraction, boolean tests and index split must lower to these integer equations.

boundaries.name: hash_and_encoding
boundaries.obligation: PoseidonRoot/PoseidonBytes32/Keccak algorithms and canonical word/byte conversions, with only concrete compared-input binding assumptions.

boundaries.name: merkle_path
boundaries.obligation: Height10 incremental proof construction, hash identity for Root leaf and swapped two-to-one path; concrete visited-tree opening obligation remains explicit.

boundaries.name: decryption_core
boundaries.obligation: Full decryption_gadget ring/key-binding/digit normalization/amount-output soundness, canonical coefficients and a/c1 nonzero checks remain a dependency. Caller only proves exact output connection.

boundaries.name: native_witness_effects
boundaries.obligation: WitnessWrite canonical conversions/unwrapped panic behavior, dynamic polynomial zip assignment, native core builder and fill effects require refinement; no admission checks are invented.

boundaries.name: native_pis_helper
boundaries.obligation: WithdrawalClaimWitness::to_public_inputs and the native decoder are separate source file, not invoked by this fill/prove. Its stronger state/E3 checks are not assumed in raw gates.

boundaries.name: l1_context
boundaries.obligation: Manager/SettlementVerifier must supply finalized closeId/H1/channel and exact payout/token, enforce backing/highwater and consume nullifiers. This callee has no such state/ledger.

boundaries.name: participant_key_policy
boundaries.obligation: Nullifier is per(closeId,leaf Regev digest,tokenSlot), not literally member-index. Cross-slot Regev uniqueness/authorization is an external registration/admission policy.

boundaries.name: fixtures
boundaries.obligation: Feature-only witness generation and unit tests were read, not translated/executed; no runtime or performance changes.
